import { Column, CreateDateColumn, Entity, Index, JoinColumn, ManyToOne, OneToMany, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Unique, UpdateDateColumn } from 'typeorm';

export enum OrderStatus {
  Pending = 'pending',
  Paid = 'paid',
  Shipped = 'shipped',
  Cancelled = 'cancelled',
}

@Entity('categories')
export class Category {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 60, unique: true })
  name!: string;

  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  description!: string | null;

  @OneToMany(() => Product, (product) => product.category)
  products!: Product[];
}

@Entity('suppliers')
export class Supplier {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 120, comment: 'Legal company name' })
  companyName!: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 254, nullable: true, unique: true })
  email!: string | null;
}

@Entity('products')
@Unique(['sku'])
export class Product {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 24 })
  sku!: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 160 })
  @Index('idx_products_name')
  name!: string;

  @Column({ type: 'numeric', precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  unitPrice!: string;

  @Column({ type: 'enum', enum: OrderStatus, default: OrderStatus.Pending })
  status!: OrderStatus;

  @Column({ default: true })
  active!: boolean;

  @ManyToOne(() => Category, { nullable: true, onDelete: 'SET NULL' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'category_id' })
  category!: Category | null;

  @ManyToOne(() => Supplier)
  supplier!: Supplier;

  @CreateDateColumn({ name: 'created_at' })
  createdAt!: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn({ name: 'updated_at' })
  updatedAt!: Date;
}

@Entity()
export class Customer {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id!: string;

  @Column()
  fullName!: string;

  @Column({ unique: true })
  email!: string;
}

@Entity('orders')
export class Order {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @ManyToOne(() => Customer, { nullable: false, onDelete: 'CASCADE' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'customer_id' })
  customer!: Customer;

  @Column({ type: 'timestamp', default: () => 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP' })
  orderedAt!: Date;

  @OneToMany(() => Product, () => undefined)
  items!: Product[];
}
